subject: Research Pipeline
executiveSummary: All deterministic contract, report, worker, supervisor/watcher, terminal-failure, and watcher-order checks passed. 4 supervised-delegation seam blockers and one release blocker remain open with owned GitHub issues; SB-4 and SB-8 are verified via ToolContext::emit_event fan-out and structured LlmWatcher nested formatting; SB-5 is verified via EventSink coalesced loss recovery; SB-6 is verified via AgentRun::start_with_watchers. The credential-gated live-provider run was not attempted because RESEARCH_PIPELINE_CHAT_MODEL and RESEARCH_PIPELINE_API_KEY are absent; v1.0 remains blocked by #258 until live verification passes.

readinessVerdict.reason: The required live-provider run is not-run because RESEARCH_PIPELINE_CHAT_MODEL and RESEARCH_PIPELINE_API_KEY are absent. No waiver has been accepted; #258 blocks v1.0 until live verification passes.

apiChecklist.requirement: Attach watchers and exercise external steering through the supervisor handle.
Observe terminal supervisor events without a fixed timeout.
Configure restart and record whether a run-level failure restarts the delegated worker.
Exercise Inject and Steer without claiming a child-worker target or cross-watcher action ordering.
Use the public watcher builder and preserve nested-event formatting and missing-model seams.
Exercise Fresh and bounded Fork context modes.
Abort a repeated fatal tool failure through the public hook seam.
Record forwarded nested events and watcher delivery boundaries.

runs.summary: All 42 contract tests passed, including canonical final-run provenance, closed enums, graph references, canonical paths, calendar dates, strict revisions and symbols, lifecycle/readiness rules, systematic privacy, and action ownership.

The complete provider-independent demo package passed 69 tests across evidence contract, isolated report path resolution and read-only checking, worker, supervisor/watcher, terminal failure, and watcher ordering; the distinct credential-gated live-provider smoke remained ignored.
Eight deterministic worker tests passed: corpus tools, fatal unsafe fault shape, threshold-one abort termination, Fresh and bounded Fork context, empty-parent error, and event rendering.

Eight deterministic tests passed: a probe activates both watcher subscriptions before second-step delegation, terminal-complete custom and LLM watcher vectors prove primary-receiver-only nested forwarding, each public steering path reaches only the supervisor history, Fresh and bounded Fork delegate, and the live-shaped helper uses start_with_watchers for first-event attachment.

The worker completed search_corpus before triggering the controlled Fatal/Unsafe fault. Indexed primary-receiver boundaries then proved nested fault failure, nested RunFailed, SubAgentFailed, parent SUB_AGENT_RUN_FAILED, and supervisor escalation in strict order. Restart was configured but no RunRestarted event was captured.

Two supervisor watchers with capacity 1024 each observed the expected stable milestone subsequence and the same complete indexed sequence with no EventsDropped observed. The test returns no actions and makes no action-order claim.
Focused orchest events:: unit tests prove coalesced secondary EventsDropped with sequence metadata, flush-before-resume, O(1) pending state under sustained saturation, and unchanged no-drop FIFO.
Five FakeAsr/FakeTts tests passed on the containing commit, confirming the historical provider-fake access gap remains resolved.

The ignored tests/smoke.rs live-provider target was not executed because RESEARCH_PIPELINE_CHAT_MODEL and RESEARCH_PIPELINE_API_KEY are absent. No waiver is granted; GitHub issue #258 owns the v1.0 live-verification gate.

evidence.summary: The v0.11 implementation overview fixes the public imports that the demo may use.
Locked design decisions list the pre-identified seams and their stable ids.
The evidence contract defines lifecycle, reference, and readiness requirements.
The strict canonical contract fixture target passed, including the containing-commit provenance guard for final executed rows.
Worker::from_paths registers search_corpus, read_file, write_draft, and fault_trigger, configures repeated_failure_threshold(1), and sets public SupervisionStrategy::Restart with one retry.
The controlled fault returns Fatal with Unsafe retry semantics, and the matching repeated-failure hook aborts the run.
The event renderer labels model turns, tool calls, tool results, nested worker events, and terminal status from RuntimeEvent values.

The focused worker target separately proves the tool error, threshold-plus-hook terminal failure, Fresh and bounded Fork histories, the empty-parent error through public Tool::call_oneshot without a model call, deterministic tools, and event rendering.

evidence.summary: The demo builds the worker through Worker::as_tool, registers it with an Orchest supervisor, instructs the fault path to call search_corpus before fault_trigger and then return an escalation summary without retrying, exposes only the supervisor RunHandle, and starts with AgentRun::start_with_watchers so declared watchers observe from RunStarted.

The custom watcher returns one public WatcherAction only for the supervisor-level research_worker ToolCallStarted event. The action and LLM wrappers record completion through terminal supervisor events; CountingWatcher maps every accepted event to a stable key and always returns Continue for delivery-only evidence.
evidence.symbol: stable_event_key and CountingWatcher::on_event and RecordingActionWatcher::on_event and RecordingLlmWatcher::on_event

evidence.summary: Watcher Inject and Steer actions are cast to the currently watched supervisor worker actor.
The run actor constructs ToolContext with event_subs (full subscriber snapshot) and event_tx (primary); ToolContext::emit_event fans out tool-originated events to primary and attached watchers.

AgentAsTool forwards child RuntimeEvent values as SubAgentEvent through ToolContext::emit_event so attached watchers receive the nested stream; the child RunHandle remains internal until wait completes.

LlmWatcher::format_event has structured arms for SubAgentStarted/Completed/Failed, SubAgentEvent, and ChildRunEvent; unit tests prove non-Debug formatting and supervisor_watcher proves runtime delivery.
LlmWatcherBuilder::build uses expect when no model was configured, causing a public library panic instead of a configuration error.

The focused target gates the first supervisor call, releases a harmless probe so queued subscriptions activate, and releases second-step delegation only after both watcher wrappers complete its ModelCallStarted event. It proves each public steering path changes only supervisor history, observes forwarded child completion on the primary EventReceiver and on both attached watchers, and reaches terminal-complete custom and LLM watcher vectors containing nested SubAgentEvent with structured LlmWatcher prompt formatting.
evidence.result: 8 passed; 0 failed; both watcher terminal-complete vectors contain forwarded SubAgentEvent

evidence.summary: The runtime emits RunRestarted only from SupervisorActor's ActorFailed branch; clean WorkerActor termination after RunFailed follows ActorTerminated instead.
Primary delivery awaits with timeout; secondaries use try_send with O(1) coalesced pending loss and EventsDropped recovery on the affected secondary (mirror to primary best-effort).

Each registered watcher is processed in its own Tokio task, and its action is applied only after that independent on_event future completes; registration order is not serialized into action application order.

The focused target gates completion on the public supervisor EventReceiver terminal event, requires completed search_corpus before fault_trigger, and extracts strict indices for nested Fatal/Unsafe failure, threshold-one abort RunFailed, SubAgentFailed, parent SUB_AGENT_RUN_FAILED, and supervisor escalation. It separately proves configured restart absence and no hook panic.
evidence.result: 1 passed; 0 failed; ordered search-to-escalation chain; no RunRestarted captured

findings.title: Delegation does not expose a child RunHandle
findings.description: AgentAsTool retains the delegated child handle internally, leaving application code with only the supervisor RunHandle.
findings.observedConsequence: A caller cannot attach a watcher to or steer the delegated worker through a public handle.
findings.workaround: Attach to the supervisor and inspect forwarded nested events on the primary EventReceiver.

action.summary: Expose a public delegated child run control and completion surface.

verification.summary: The authentic public-surface attempt consumes and waits the only owned supervisor RunHandle while preserving the distinct child run id observed in forwarded evidence; no public child-handle constructor or lookup exists.

findings.title: Steering targets the supervisor rather than delegated worker
findings.description: Watcher and external Inject or Steer actions target the watched supervisor actor when delegation uses AgentAsTool.
findings.observedConsequence: Application code cannot direct a message specifically to the delegated worker.
findings.workaround: Use supervisor-level steering and preserve the target mismatch as evidence.

action.summary: Route public delegated child inject and steer operations through the child control surface.

verification.summary: The custom WatcherAction is triggered specifically by the supervisor-level research_worker ToolCallStarted event. WatcherAction::Inject, WatcherAction::Steer, RunHandle::inject_message, and RunHandle::steer all appeared in supervisor model histories and in none of the Fresh delegated-worker messages.

findings.title: Restart does not cover run-level failure
findings.description: Restart reacts to actor crashes rather than RunFailed outcomes from tool errors, budgets, or max steps.
findings.observedConsequence: A delegated worker can terminally fail without the configured restart policy recovering it.
findings.workaround: Use repeated-failure abort and supervisor escalation while recording restart absence.

action.summary: Apply bounded delegated-run restart policy to run-level failures and emit restart evidence.

verification.summary: Restart with max_retries one was configured on the delegated worker. After a successful search_corpus step, indexed evidence showed the controlled RunFailed, SubAgentFailed, parent SUB_AGENT_RUN_FAILED, and supervisor RunCompleted escalation in order without panic; no RunRestarted event was captured, matching the ActorFailed-only source branch.

findings.title: LlmWatcher does not format nested delegation events
findings.description: LlmWatcher formatting has no dedicated handler for SubAgentEvent, child lifecycle, or child run events.
findings.observedConsequence: Pre-fix: nested events fell back to debug-style text and attached watchers missed them because of SB-8.
findings.workaround: Use the public watcher unchanged for supervisor events and render primary-receiver nested events separately for human traces.

action.summary: Added structured LlmWatcher formatting for delegated child lifecycle and runtime events.

verification.summary: LlmWatcher::format_event emits structured text for SubAgentStarted/Completed/Failed, SubAgentEvent, and ChildRunEvent. Attached LlmWatcher receives and formats nested events in supervisor_watcher after SB-8 repair (unit coverage lives in orchest::run::llm_watcher).

findings.title: Secondary watcher subscribers can drop events
findings.description: Secondary watcher subscriptions use non-blocking delivery and can lose events under backpressure.
findings.observedConsequence: A watcher has no recovery path for dropped events when its channel is full.
findings.workaround: Prefer capacity that avoids saturation; when EventsDropped arrives on a secondary, treat the gap as bounded (payloads not replayed) and continue or resubscribe for future events.

action.summary: Secondary loss coalesces into O(1) pending state and surfaces as EventsDropped { subscriber_id, count, from_seq, to_seq } on the affected secondary once capacity frees (mirror to primary best-effort). Lost payloads are not replayed.

verification.summary: Saturation unit tests prove coalesced secondary EventsDropped with sequence metadata, flush-before-resume, and O(1) pending state; watcher_order remains the no-drop FIFO equivalence check.

findings.title: No public start-with-watchers or pre-run pause seam
findings.description: AgentRun::start schedules execution before application code can attach watchers, and no public pre-run pause or watcher constructor seam exists.
findings.observedConsequence: Application code cannot guarantee observation beginning with the first runtime event or first model call.
findings.workaround: Use AgentRun::start_with_watchers for first-event guarantees; post-start attach_watcher remains best-effort.

action.summary: Added AgentRun::start_with_watchers which pre-wires watchers before RunStarted.

verification.summary: Live helper uses AgentRun::start_with_watchers so declared watchers observe from RunStarted; post-start attach_watcher remains best-effort. Deterministic suite still passes.

findings.title: Watcher actions have no global registration-order guarantee
findings.description: Each watcher runs independently, so actions returned by multiple watchers do not have a global registration-order execution guarantee.
findings.observedConsequence: Concurrent Inject, Steer, or Abort actions cannot be attributed to watcher registration order.
findings.workaround: Test per-watcher FIFO separately and do not claim cross-watcher action ordering.

action.summary: Define and implement deterministic arbitration for actions from multiple watchers.

verification.summary: The delivery-only CountingWatchers preserve FIFO and receive equivalent indexed sequences, but return no actions. Source shows one independent Tokio task per watcher and applies each action after its own on_event future, so registration order is not a global action-order contract.

findings.title: Forwarded child events bypass attached watchers
findings.description: ToolContext.event_tx is the primary subscriber sender, and AgentAsTool forwards child events directly through it rather than through attached watcher subscription channels.
findings.observedConsequence: Pre-fix: primary EventReceiver observed SubAgentEvent values but supervisor-attached watchers could not.
findings.workaround: Consume primary-receiver nested events separately and treat attached watchers as supervisor-event observers.

action.summary: Delivered forwarded delegated child events to attached watcher subscriptions via ToolContext::emit_event.

verification.summary: Attached watchers receive forwarded SubAgentEvent values via ToolContext::emit_event; primary remains single-delivery; activation-before-delegation holds. Deterministic supervisor_watcher proves nested delivery on custom and LlmWatcher vectors.

findings.title: LlmWatcher builder panics without a model
findings.description: The current builder uses expect when model configuration is absent instead of returning a configuration error.
findings.observedConsequence: A caller configuration mistake can panic library code before v1.0 freezes the API.
findings.workaround: Supply the model before calling the current infallible build method.

action.summary: Make LlmWatcherBuilder::build return a configuration error when model is absent.

verification.summary: Source inspection confirms the panic path; GitHub issue #255 owns the fallible API repair and verifier.

findings.title: LlmWatcher is not root re-exported
findings.description: The watcher requires a deeper public import path than other related watcher APIs.
findings.observedConsequence: The public surface is less discoverable but remains usable.
findings.workaround: Use the documented public module path.

action.summary: Add a convenience LlmWatcher re-export without removing the existing public path.

verification.summary: The reviewed release decision defers import-path polish to the post-1.0 backlog under #256.

findings.title: ContextMode is not root re-exported
findings.description: ContextMode requires a deeper public import path than adjacent APIs.
findings.observedConsequence: The public surface is less discoverable but remains usable.
findings.workaround: Use the documented public module path.

action.summary: Add a convenience ContextMode re-export without removing the existing public path.

verification.summary: The reviewed release decision defers import-path polish to the post-1.0 backlog under #256.

findings.title: Fork empty-parent context error is unreachable
findings.description: Normal agent flow always supplies parent messages, leaving the empty-parent defensive error unreachable during delegation; public Tool::call_oneshot supplies the empty throwaway context needed to exercise it.
findings.observedConsequence: Normal delegation cannot reach the branch, while a focused one-shot invocation can verify it without private context construction.
findings.workaround: Exercise the agent tool through public Tool::call_oneshot and retain separate normal Fresh and bounded Fork evidence.

action.summary: Reconcile the empty-parent Fork error with the supported delegation contract.

verification.summary: The focused test invokes the Fork agent tool through public Tool::call_oneshot, observes EMPTY_PARENT_CONTEXT without a model call, and separately passes Fresh and bounded Fork paths; #257 owns the deferred contract cleanup.

findings.title: Delegation has no explicit child completion receiver
findings.description: Delegated worker completion is consumed by AgentAsTool and does not expose a separate child EventReceiver.
findings.observedConsequence: Application-level completion can only be gated through the supervisor event receiver.
findings.workaround: Wait for the supervisor terminal event and observe nested completion through forwarded events.

action.summary: Expose delegated child completion through the public child control surface.

verification.summary: The controlled failure loop receives forwarded child RunFailed and SubAgentFailed on the primary supervisor EventReceiver, then gates application completion on the supervisor RunCompleted terminal event without a fixed timeout.

findings.title: Provider test fakes were previously inaccessible
findings.description: The earlier fake-provider access gap was resolved by GitHub issue #196 and commit 8bb9a9b, which exposed FakeAsr and FakeTts behind the testing feature.
findings.observedConsequence: Downstream deterministic tests and demos can consume provider fakes without maintaining local duplicates.
findings.workaround: No workaround remains necessary; use orchest-provider::fakes with the testing feature.

action.summary: Resolved reusable FakeAsr and FakeTts access behind the testing feature.

verification.summary: All five focused FakeAsr/FakeTts tests passed on the current tree; the historical repair remains verified.
